entries.title: Exodus 17:1
segments: And all the congregation of the sons of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the command of the Lord, and pitched in Rephidim. And [there was] no water for the people to drink.

entries.title: Exodus 17:2
segments: And the people wrangled with Moses and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said to them, Why do you wrangle with me? Why do you tempt the LORD?

entries.title: Exodus 17:3
segments: And the people thirsted there for water. And the people murmured against Moses and said, Why [is] this, [that] You brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our sons and our cattle with thirst?

entries.title: Exodus 17:4
segments: And Moses cried to the LORD, saying, What shall I do to this people? They are almost ready to stone me.

entries.title: Exodus 17:5
segments: And the LORD said to Moses, Go on in front of the people, and take with you the elders of Israel. And take your rod with which you struck the river, in your hand, and go.

entries.title: Exodus 17:6
segments: Behold, I will stand before you there upon the rock in Horeb. And you shall smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, so that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.

entries.title: Exodus 17:7
segments: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the wrangling of the sons of Israel, and because they tempted the LORD, saying, Is the LORD among us or not?

entries.title: Exodus 17:8
segments: Then Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

entries.title: Exodus 17:9
segments: And Moses said to Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out to fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in my hand.

entries.title: Exodus 17:10
segments: And Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek. And Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

entries.title: Exodus 17:11
segments: And it happened when Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed. And when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

entries.title: Exodus 17:12
segments: But Moses' hands [became] heavy. And they took a stone and put [it] under him, and he sat on it. And Aaron and Hur held up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side. And his hands were steady until the going of the sun.

entries.title: Exodus 17:13
segments: And Joshua defeated Amalek and his people by the mouth of the sword.

entries.title: Exodus 17:14
segments: And the LORD said to Moses, Write this, a memorial in a book, and set [it] in the ears of Joshua, that I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heavens.

entries.title: Exodus 17:15
segments: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovah My Banner.

entries.title: Exodus 17:16
segments: And he said, A hand [is] on the throne of the LORD; war is to the LORD with Amalek from generation to generation.
